# regapi_domain_quote (Data Source)

Whether a name can be registered now and what it costs for the default term, asked of the registry live. Use price_cents as expected_price_cents.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "regapi_domain_quote" "client" {
  domain_name = "client.gr"
}

output "price" {
  value = data.regapi_domain_quote.client.registrable ? data.regapi_domain_quote.client.price_cents : null
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) The name to check.

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Price currency.
- `price_cents` (Number) Price in cents for the default term.
- `reason` (String) Why not, for example domain_unavailable.
- `registrable` (Boolean) Whether the name can be registered.
- `years` (Number) The default term.
